capabilities: Assign colored SVG icons to files by extension
Recognize folders by name (src, docs, assets, etc.) and icon them
Update icons in real time on create, delete and rename
Fall back to a generic icon for unmapped items
disambiguation: Does not add icons to note content or the editor; it only decorates items in the file explorer.
extras: README is in Portuguese; states the plugin runs locally and sends no vault data or external resources; describes cleanup of injected SVGs and observers on disable.
problem: The file explorer shows generic icons, making it hard to distinguish file types and folder purposes at a glance.

relations.evidence: Os ícones foram inspirados no projeto open source Material Icon Theme

summary: Icon set in the VS Code Material Theme style that colors files and folders in the file explorer by extension and folder name.
